mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT c.user_id FROM cart c INNER JOIN cart_item ci ON c.cart_id = ci.cart_id WHERE ci.added_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '3 days' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.user_id = c.user_id AND o.ordered_at > ci.added_at )
SELECT user_id FROM user_membership WHERE status = 'CANCELLED' GROUP BY user_id
SELECT user_id FROM orders GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 1 AND MAX(ordered_at) < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'

SELECT DISTINCT w.user_id FROM wishlist w WHERE w.created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM orders o INNER JOIN orders_item oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.ordered_at > w.created_at AND w.product_id = oi.product_id AND o.user_id = w.user_id )
SELECT user_id FROM user_coupons WHERE used = false AND expires_at >= CURRENT_DATE AND expires_at <= CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '3 days' GROUP BY user_id
SELECT user_id FROM reviews WHERE rating < 2 UNION SELECT user_id FROM orders WHERE order_status IN ('CANCELLED', 'RETURNED')
SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE last_login_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND role = 'ROLE_USER'

SELECT user_id FROM orders WHERE order_status NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'RETURNED') GROUP BY user_id HAVING SUM( CASE WHEN ordered_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' THEN total_price ELSE 0 END ) -- 창A (최근 30일) < SUM( CASE WHEN ordered_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' AND ordered_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '60 days' THEN total_price ELSE 0 END ) * 0.5 -- 창B (직전 30일) × 0.5 AND SUM( CASE WHEN ordered_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' AND ordered_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '60 days' THEN total_price ELSE 0 END ) >= 30000 -- 직전 30일 최소 지출 — "쓰던 고객의 반토막"만. 0원 휴면은 LOGIN_INACTIVE 담당 (2026-07-25 정밀화)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO churn_score ( user_id, score, risk_level, risk_type, source ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{score}, #{riskLevel}, #{riskType}, #{source} )
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM churn_score cs WHERE cs.source = 'RULE' AND cs.scored_at::date = CURRENT_DATE AND cs.demo_tag IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM retention_intervention ri WHERE ri.churn_score_id = cs.churn_score_id )
mapper.select:
SELECT churn_score_id, user_id, risk_type FROM churn_score cs WHERE scored_at::date = CURRENT_DATE AND risk_type IN ('FIRST_ORDER_ONLY') AND source = 'RULE' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM retention_intervention ri WHERE ri.user_id = cs.user_id AND ri.risk_type = cs.risk_type AND ri.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' )
ORDER BY cs.score DESC, cs.user_id

SELECT churn_score_id, user_id, risk_type FROM churn_score cs WHERE scored_at::date = CURRENT_DATE AND risk_type IN
#{type}
AND source = 'RULE' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM retention_intervention ri WHERE ri.user_id = cs.user_id AND ri.risk_type = cs.risk_type AND ri.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' )
ORDER BY cs.score DESC, cs.user_id

mapper.select: SELECT churn_score_id AS churnScoreId, user_id AS userId, score, risk_level AS riskLevel, risk_type AS riskType, source, scored_at AS scoredAt FROM churn_score WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND risk_type = #{riskType} ORDER BY churn_score_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM churn_score WHERE source = 'RULE' AND scored_at::date = CURRENT_DATE AND demo_tag IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM retention_intervention WHERE created_at::date = CURRENT_DATE AND demo_tag IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM retention_intervention WHERE created_at::date = CURRENT_DATE AND demo_tag IS NULL AND is_control
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_coupons (user_id, coupon_id, used, issued_at, expires_at, issued_by) VALUES (#{userId}, #{couponId}, FALSE, NOW(), CAST(#{expiresAt} AS DATE), 'CHURN')
mapper.select: SELECT uc.coupon_id AS "couponId", COUNT(*) AS "cnt" FROM user_coupons uc WHERE uc.issued_at::date = CURRENT_DATE AND uc.issued_by = 'CHURN' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM retention_intervention r WHERE r.user_id = uc.user_id AND r.created_at::date = CURRENT_DATE AND r.demo_tag IS NULL) GROUP BY uc.coupon_id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_coupons uc WHERE uc.issued_at::date = CURRENT_DATE AND uc.issued_by = 'CHURN' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM retention_intervention r WHERE r.user_id = uc.user_id AND r.created_at::date = CURRENT_DATE AND r.demo_tag IS NULL)
mapper.update: UPDATE coupons SET quantity = quantity + #{cnt} WHERE coupon_id = #{couponId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM notifications n WHERE n.created_at::date = CURRENT_DATE AND n.demo_tag IS NULL AND n.type IN ('COMEBACK', 'COUPON_EXPIRE', 'ABANDON', 'APOLOGY', 'REBUY', 'WELCOME_BACK', 'RECOMMEND', 'WISHLIST') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM retention_intervention r WHERE r.user_id = n.user_id AND r.created_at::date = CURRENT_DATE AND r.demo_tag IS NULL)
DELETE FROM intervention_outcome io WHERE io.intervention_id IN ( SELECT intervention_id FROM retention_intervention WHERE created_at::date = CURRENT_DATE AND demo_tag IS NULL)
DELETE FROM retention_intervention WHERE created_at::date = CURRENT_DATE AND demo_tag IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM retention_intervention WHERE created_at::date = CURRENT_DATE
SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM retention_intervention WHERE risk_type IN ('FIRST_ORDER_ONLY', 'LOGIN_INACTIVE')
